children: Gold edges higher in a likely technical rebound after falling overnight. The precious metal has fallen below $3,900 an ounce as higher oil prices fuel expectations of rate hikes, ANZ Research analysts say in a research note. Strong U.S. economic data suggests that the Federal Reserve could even deliver a 50-basis-point hike in December, they say. A renewed sell-off in bond markets has sent yields higher and is weighing on investor appetite for the nonyielding asset. The U.S. dollar index's rise above 103 puts further pressure on the yellow metal, they add. Spot gold is up 0.1% at $3,880.00 an ounce. (sherry.qin@wsj.com)
